title: intellilens
tagline: intellilens is a data aggregation layer enabling creators, projects and users to make better, data based decisions.
description: intellilens is a data aggregation layer on top of the lens BigQuery public dataset with the goal to enable actionable data insights. The data can be used for dashboards, google analytics like applications, detailed analysis (publication, user, content, app based) or enriched with other data sources.
how_its_made:
intellilens is a data aggregation layer on top of the lens BigQuery public dataset with the goal to enable actionable data insights. The data can be used for dashboards, google analytics like applications, detailed analysis (publication, user, content, app based) or enriched with other data sources.
On top of the 2 data (aggregation) layers looker studio is used for reporting.
